CREATE TABLE [EDS].[DEPOSIT_NONPHP_YTD]
( 
	[FULLDATE] [date]  NULL,
	[PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY] [date]  NULL,
	[CUST_ID] [varchar](9)  NULL,
	[GAM_ACID] [varchar](11)  NULL,
	[ACCT_CRNCY_CODE] [varchar](3)  NULL,
	[GAM_BANK_ID] [varchar](8)  NULL,
	[GAM_SCHM_TYPE] [varchar](3)  NULL,
	[CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE] [numeric](25,4)  NULL,
	[CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP] [numeric](25,4)  NULL,
	[PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE] [numeric](25,4)  NULL,
	[PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP] [numeric](25,4)  NULL,
	[TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE] [numeric](38,4)  NULL,
	[TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP] [numeric](38,4)  NULL,
	[DAYOFYEAR] [smallint]  NULL,
	[YTD_BALANCE] [numeric](38,6)  NULL,
	[YTD_BALANCE_PHP] [numeric](38,6)  NULL,
	[MONTH_END] [varchar](1)  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = HASH ( [CUST_ID] ),
	HEAP
)
GO
